name: Arcade (MAME, FBNeo, NAOMI, Atomiswave)
_notes: Player-1 style generic panel; ports are separate player slots. The joystick is modelled as 'dpad'. Button numbering follows standalone MAME's XInput defaults (B1=A, B2=B, B3=X, B4=Y, B5=LB, B6=RB, B7=LT, B8=RT). FBNeo and MAME libretro remap per driver. 6-button fighters (CPS2) want the fightpad-6 preset (LP/MP/HP = west/north/r1, LK/MK/HK = south/east/r2). Analog cabinet controls (wheels, trackballs, lightguns, spinners) are not modelled. Neo Geo has its own layout (neogeo.json).
